deck_goal: Produce a research-backed executive deck on AI use cases in insurance, anchored on Progressive as the named customer.
theme_reference: Use the branded executive slide system already established in this repo.
story_arc: Why Progressive is the right customer lens

slides.title: Insurance AI Use Cases For Progressive

content_blocks.label: Subtitle
content_blocks.body: Industry + customer + executive action

content_blocks.label: Strapline
content_blocks.body: For insurance, the most valuable AI programs are workflow-led. For Progressive, the strongest priorities are pricing and telematics, claims orchestration, bundle growth, service automation, and core modernization.

slides.title: Insurance AI Is An Operating Model Decision

content_blocks.label: Section note
content_blocks.body: The strongest insurance AI programs are no longer side pilots. They sit in underwriting, claims, service, growth, and modernization workflows that move real economics.

content_blocks.label: Workflow AI beats chatbot AI
content_blocks.body: Insurance value comes from underwriting, claims, service, and modernization workflows with measurable economics.

content_blocks.label: Progressive is already AI-ready
content_blocks.body: The account already runs telematics, product-model iteration, digital claims, and omnichannel service at scale.

content_blocks.label: Pricing and claims are the top wedges
content_blocks.body: These lanes map best to Progressive's current model and to the industry's highest-value patterns.

content_blocks.label: Bundle growth is the hidden opportunity
content_blocks.body: Progressive explicitly treats bundled home-and-auto households as an under-penetrated strategic segment.

slides.title: Why The Insurance Market Supports This Bet

content_blocks.label: Personal P&C premiums
content_blocks.body: $1.1T|McKinsey says personal P&C represented about 1.1 trillion dollars of GWP in 2023.

content_blocks.label: Claims accuracy uplift
content_blocks.body: 3-5%|McKinsey cites claims accuracy improvement from domain-level AI rewiring.

content_blocks.label: Onboarding cost reduction
content_blocks.body: 20-40%|McKinsey cites lower onboarding cost in leading AI programs.

content_blocks.label: Operations drive performance
content_blocks.body: 60%|McKinsey says around 60 percent of insurer performance is driven by how the company operates.

content_blocks.label: Takeaway
content_blocks.body: This is a large market where process quality and operating-model quality dominate outcomes.

slides.title: Insurance AI: Old Framing Versus Executive Reality

content_blocks.label: Weak framing
content_blocks.body: Generic chatbot launch|Small copilots with no owner|Innovation theater|No tie to pricing, claims, or growth

content_blocks.label: Strong framing
content_blocks.body: Workflow automation with owners|AI inside underwriting and claims|Measured economics|Modernization that enables repeated change

slides.title: What Actually Creates Value In Insurance

content_blocks.label: Repeated workflow
content_blocks.body: The best lanes are repeated, high-volume, document-heavy, and already instrumented.

content_blocks.label: Decision quality
content_blocks.body: Value comes from better pricing, faster claims, sharper routing, and lower cost-to-serve.

content_blocks.label: Data loop
content_blocks.body: The strongest insurers connect customer, policy, claims, and servicing data into one feedback loop.

content_blocks.label: Operating system
content_blocks.body: AI becomes durable when it changes how the insurer operates, not just how it communicates.

slides.title: Why Progressive Is The Right Customer To Anchor

content_blocks.label: Section note
content_blocks.body: Progressive is not a generic insurance target. It is a scaled, digitally distributed carrier already optimized around pricing, telematics, and workflow speed.

content_blocks.label: Scaled carrier
content_blocks.body: Progressive reported 37.3 million companywide policies in force at June 30, 2025.

content_blocks.label: Digital distribution
content_blocks.body: Customers buy and use insurance online, by phone, by app, or through agents.

content_blocks.label: Usage-based edge
content_blocks.body: Snapshot and continuous monitoring are part of the current operating model, not a side experiment.

content_blocks.label: Growth agenda
content_blocks.body: Progressive is pushing product iteration, new business growth, and bundling in under-penetrated segments.

content_blocks.label: Companywide policies in force
content_blocks.body: 37.3M|June 30, 2025 results

content_blocks.label: Total personal lines PIF
content_blocks.body: 36.1M|June 30, 2025 results

content_blocks.label: Snapshot average savings
content_blocks.body: $322|Progressive telematics page

content_blocks.label: Snapshot continuous monitoring footprint
content_blocks.body: 75%|Of auto net premiums written, excluding California

content_blocks.label: Takeaway
content_blocks.body: Progressive already has the scale and digital instrumentation to justify workflow-led AI investment.

slides.title: Why Progressive Is Different From A Generic Carrier

content_blocks.label: Generic insurer pitch
content_blocks.body: Broad transformation story|High-level service bot demos|No clear account wedge|Weak tie to current workflows

content_blocks.label: Progressive-specific pitch
content_blocks.body: Pricing and telematics leverage|Claims orchestration|Bundle growth expansion|Service and modernization tied to scale economics

content_blocks.label: Section note
content_blocks.body: The right ordering is not based on novelty. It is based on account fit, measurable economics, and readiness of the existing workflow.

slides.title: Business Use Cases That Matter Most
slides.objective: Summarize the use cases in one table.

content_blocks.label: Telematics pricing and underwriting
content_blocks.body: Use behavioral and external data to improve risk selection, conversion quality, and retention.

content_blocks.label: Claims orchestration
content_blocks.body: Automate intake, evidence routing, next-best action, and customer updates to cut cycle time.

content_blocks.label: Bundle growth
content_blocks.body: Identify the right households and moments for home-plus-auto expansion and retention.

content_blocks.label: Service automation
content_blocks.body: Improve routing and routine issue handling across web, app, phone, and agent channels.

content_blocks.label: Modernization factory
content_blocks.body: Use agentic workflows to accelerate product logic, testing, documentation, and release work.

slides.title: Industry Need Versus Progressive Fit
slides.objective: Tie general industry need to customer-specific fit.

content_blocks.label: Industry need
content_blocks.body: Better pricing|Faster claims|Cheaper service|Smarter growth|Faster change

content_blocks.label: Progressive fit
content_blocks.body: Snapshot and external data|Digital FNOL and accident response|Omnichannel servicing|Bundle-first expansion|Rapid product-model iteration

content_blocks.label: Section note
content_blocks.body: Each of these programs already has an owner, a measurable business job, and evidence that Progressive is ready to act.

content_blocks.label: Current account signal
content_blocks.body: Snapshot provides automatic discounting and personalized pricing, while continuous monitoring covers most of Progressive's auto premium base.

content_blocks.label: Executive logic
content_blocks.body: This is already core to Progressive's customer proposition, so incremental AI here maps directly to underwriting and growth economics.

content_blocks.label: What to sell
content_blocks.body: Risk segmentation, quote quality, pricing optimization, and retention interventions tied to telematics behavior.

content_blocks.label: Implications
content_blocks.body: Lead with measurable lift in risk selection|Tie the program to conversion and retention|Do not pitch this as a generic personalization layer

content_blocks.label: Current account signal
content_blocks.body: Progressive already supports digital claim access, guest claim reporting, app-based accident response, and faster FNOL goals.

content_blocks.label: Executive logic
content_blocks.body: Claims is a visible customer workflow where cycle time, routing quality, and service quality all matter financially.

content_blocks.label: What to sell
content_blocks.body: Triage, document extraction, claim summarization, next-best action, and claimant communication orchestration.

content_blocks.label: Implications
content_blocks.body: Anchor on cycle time and service metrics|Stay close to existing digital entry points|Frame AI as workflow execution, not just summarization

content_blocks.label: Current account signal
content_blocks.body: Progressive says bundled home-and-auto households are its largest under-penetrated property segment and is actively prioritizing bundles.

content_blocks.label: Executive logic
content_blocks.body: This is a revenue and lifetime-value program, not just a marketing optimization problem.

content_blocks.label: What to sell
content_blocks.body: Household propensity models, timing recommendations, agent prompts, and cross-channel offer orchestration.

content_blocks.label: Implications
content_blocks.body: Position this as growth infrastructure|Tie the motion to household expansion and retention|Connect service and distribution data

content_blocks.label: Current account signal
content_blocks.body: Progressive serves customers online, by app, by phone, and through agents, making orchestration a real operational challenge.

content_blocks.label: Executive logic
content_blocks.body: The value is lower cost-to-serve and more consistent issue resolution across channels.

content_blocks.label: What to sell
content_blocks.body: Routing, service summarization, task automation, and agent-assist flows that preserve channel choice.

content_blocks.label: Implications
content_blocks.body: Do not over-index on chatbot containment|Show how orchestration lowers handling time|Keep human escalation explicit

content_blocks.label: Current account signal
content_blocks.body: Progressive is already iterating product models and external-data logic, which makes faster documentation, testing, and release work economically relevant.

content_blocks.label: Executive logic
content_blocks.body: Modernization is a business enabler because it determines how quickly the carrier can scale other AI programs.

content_blocks.label: What to sell
content_blocks.body: Agentic documentation, legacy knowledge capture, test generation, and release orchestration.

content_blocks.label: Implications
content_blocks.body: Tie this to throughput and rework|Frame it as a modernization factory|Keep controls and auditability explicit

content_blocks.label: Section note
content_blocks.body: The main executive job is sequencing: invest where Progressive already has data, workflow ownership, and measurable value pools.

content_blocks.label: Fund pricing and telematics first
content_blocks.body: This is the cleanest fit with Progressive's current model and strongest economics.

content_blocks.label: Package claims as orchestration
content_blocks.body: Lead with FNOL, routing, documentation, and service quality, not generic AI claims summaries.

content_blocks.label: Treat bundle AI as a growth program
content_blocks.body: Use household and cross-line orchestration to attack a segment Progressive has already named as strategic.

content_blocks.label: Use modernization to unlock scale
content_blocks.body: Support all other AI programs with faster product, testing, and documentation cycles.
Land pricing and claims pilots|Start with the two workflows that already have strong digital exhaust and obvious financial metrics.
Expand into bundle growth and service orchestration|Use the first wave to unify household and service data across channels.
Stand up modernization factory capabilities|Use agentic delivery patterns to accelerate the product and platform layer underneath the business use cases.
Institutionalize governance and KPI review|Track lift in pricing quality, claims cycle time, bundle conversion, and service cost-to-serve.

content_blocks.label: Pitching generic AI instead of workflow AI
Treating modernization as separate from use cases
